items.title: OpenAI’s next big AI model has ‘entered the AGI era’
items.summary: OpenAI's next big model is here: GPT-6 Astra. The company calls it a "generational leap in capability" for areas like cybersecurity, professional work, software engineering, science, and computer use. items.title: Nvidia launches free tool that links idle computers into a personal AI data center
items.summary: Nvidia is announcing its new Personal AI Router (PAIR), a free tool that syncs up your home computers for tackling local AI inference tasks with tools like Ollama and LM Studio. items.title: Google now lets you chat with Gmail, Docs, and Keep
items.summary: Google is rolling out AI-powered voice assistant modes for Gmail, Docs, and Keep that allow you to manage the apps by talking to them. items.title: ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude all went down at the same time
items.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT, xAI's Grok, and Anthropic's Claude are back online after they all began experiencing issues around the same time on Thursday. At about 11AM ET, ChatGPT started returning error messages for users trying to use the chatbot, with its status page saying there were "elevated errors across ChatGPT and Codex." items.title: Google says its AI weather model is getting better

items.title: Nvidia is buying Hugging Face for almost $13 billion
items.summary: Nvidia has agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, bringing one of the most popular hosting platforms for open-source AI models, datasets, and tools under the ownership of the world's biggest AI chipmaker.
